theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (μ₀ ξ : Measure X), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ₀ → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts ξ → ξ ≪ μ₀ → ∃ g : X → ℝ, Measurable g ∧ (∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → IntegrableOn g K μ₀) ∧ ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ, Integrable (fun x => f x * g x) μ₀ ∧ ∫ x, f x ∂ξ = ∫ x, f x * g x ∂μ₀
